summary.name: GPTGO
summary.one_liner: GPTGO (GPTGO.AI) is a free web search engine that shows Google-based search results alongside ChatGPT-generated answers.
use_cases: Getting a quick AI-written answer alongside regular web search results
Researching topics for study or reference
Drafting or editing documents and emails with a chatbot
Finding book, music, or movie suggestions
Generating stories, scripts, or song lyrics
Searching and asking questions in many languages
summary.what_it_does: GPTGO combines Google search results with an integrated "Ask GPT" chatbot feature, so each search can also return a short ChatGPT-style answer. Users can continue the conversation with the chat AI for more detailed responses. The site lets users copy or download the generated responses. It states that it supports more than 100 languages and does not store user information. A mobile app called UniChat is mentioned for Android and iOS, and the site also suggests setting GPTGO as the default search engine or bookmarking it.
notable: Combines Google search results with a ChatGPT answer on each query
No account or sign-up required, per the FAQ
Mobile app UniChat for Android and iOS
Claims not to store or track user information
caveats: Page states it cannot answer recently updated information
Page makes accuracy claims with no independent verification
Platforms beyond web and mobile are described only generically as 'PC'; no desktop app is named
